description: Four signals held inside a voltage window set by two knobs, in 2HP, with a mode switch that turns the window into a difference or a gate instead

params.text: Sets the bottom of the window, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and -5V unless you move it
Sets the top of the window, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and +5V unless you move it
Mirrors the Max knob onto the Min knob while it is on, so setting Min to -3V puts Max at +3V
Chooses what the outputs carry: Clp. holds the input inside the window, Diff gives how far outside it went, Gate gives a high or low level according to whether it went outside

inputs.text: One of the four signals to be measured against the window; a light beside it brightens whenever that signal goes outside and then fades

outputs.text: Carries that input held inside the window, or the amount by which it overflowed, or a gate, whichever the mode switch is set to

notes: setting Min above Max turns the window inside out and the signal is flipped within it, which a small red light beside Min shows; that inversion applies in Clp. mode only
this module has no clipping range on its menu, because the Min and Max knobs already bound every output
menu: Diff-mode: Relative, Absolute — chooses whether the Diff output keeps the sign of the overflow or reports it as a positive number
Gate-mode: High when out of range, High when in range — chooses which way round the Gate output reads the window
Oversampling mode: Single sample, 2x oversampling — runs the clamp at twice the sample rate, which is worth it on audio and off unless you turn it on
Set min/max-range — sets the two knobs to a named pair, from -1 to +1 up to unipolar 0 to +10, each also offered with the ends swapped for inversion
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage the Gate mode output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage the Gate mode output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
